result.title: Reinforcement-Aligned Probabilistic Weather Forecasting with Discrete Tokens
result.summary: Global medium-range weather forecasting must not only generate ensembles efficiently to characterize uncertainty in future states, but also serve downstream applications such as extreme-event warnings and cross-sphere coupled simulations. We introduce WeatherCraft, a framework that unifies probabilistic generation and reinforcement learning alignment through discrete weather tokens, bringing the GPT-style pretraining--post-training paradigm to global medium-range weather forecasting. A multiscale tokenizer represents atmospheric states as a coarse-to-fine token hierarchy, while a Transformer models causal dependencies across time and scale and predicts tokens within each scale in parallel. Direct sampling generates diverse ensembles, and exact token log-probabilities enable Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to maximize downstream task rewards without differentiating through evaluators or coupled models. On the ERA5 benchmark, WeatherCraft's eight-member ensemble mean reduces day-15 normalized RMSE by 17.6% relative to the strongest evaluated deterministic baseline and, with KV caching, achieves an approximately $18\times$ inference speedup over GenCast. Direct fair-CRPS adaptation improves ensemble probabilistic skill, while reward-based post-training improves forecasts of persistent land temperature extremes and coupled ocean heat extremes. This work establishes discrete autoregressive modeling as a general foundation for scalable, task-alignable Earth system foundation models.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 WeatherCraft，用多尺度 coarse-to-fine 离散天气 token 表示大气状态，由 Transformer 建模跨时间与跨尺度的因果依赖并在各尺度内并行预测 token，从而直接采样生成集合预报，并借助 token 精确对数概率做 GRPO 后训练以对齐下游任务奖励。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分层离散状态表示与「尺度内并行、跨尺度因果」的生成结构，以及用精确 token 似然做序列级奖励优化而无需对评估器求导的做法，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态组织、并行生成与轨迹监督分配提供方法线索，需核查其是否只适配数值场预报。
